{{*}} [[Portal Chamber]] of [[Player-owned house|POH]] {{*}} [[Salve Graveyard Teleport]] |music = [[Village]] |map = {{Map|name=Canifis|x=3493|y=3488}} |type = settlement |leagueRegion = Morytania }} {{Relative location |location = Canifis |north = Slayer Tower |east = Haunted Woods |south = Mort Myre Swamp |west = Paterdomus }} '''Canifis''' is a small town in [[Morytania]] inhabited by [[Werewolf|werewolves]] in human form. The town is only accessible to players who have completed the [[Priest in Peril]] [[Quests|quest]]. Canifis is the starting point for the [[Myreque quest series|Myreque storyline]]. ==Transportation== Several teleports bring players into or close to Canifis, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest: * {{Plink|Kharyrll Teleport}} — [[Hair of the Dog]] pub next to [[Canifis bank|Canifis Bank]]. * {{Plink|Slayer ring}} — [[Slayer Tower]] entrance north of the town. * {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon|txt=Fairy code}} {{Fairycode|CKS}} — just west of Canifis. * {{Plink|Fenkenstrain's Castle Teleport|txt=Fenkenstrain teleport}} — [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]], north-east of the town. * {{Plink|Salve Graveyard Teleport|txt=Salve Graveyard teleport}} — slightly west of the town. * {{Plink|Ectophial}} — [[Ectofuntus]], far east of the town. ==History== Before the [[God Wars]], a [[Zaros|Zarosian]] fortress known as [[Kharyrll]] once stood here. The fortress was destroyed during the [[God Wars]] by Zamorakian forces as part of the destruction of the [[Zarosian Empire]].{{CiteNPC|npc=Golem (Desert Treasure II)|quote=Kharyrll was completely destroyed by Zamorakian forces.}} In the year 23 of the [[Fifth Age]], a group of werewolves built the village now named Canifis at the place where Kharyrll once stood.{{CiteText|text=Display case (Varrock Museum, number 32)|quote=5th Age - yr 23
An evil vampyre lord started to take control over northern Morytania and his minions visited the various human groups in the area demanding blood tithes, causing widespread panic. Werewolves founded a settlement near to the temple. From the few survivors, we learned that most of the human inhabitants eventually succumbed and paid the blood tithe imposed by the vampyres. Only the inhabitants of Castle Fenkenstrain stood up to this evil influence. }} Like all subjects in Morytania, they are forced to pay blood tithes to the vampyres, whether it be through captured humans, or offering one of their own if necessary.{{CiteNPC|npc=Roavar|quote=In return for our allegiance, and the tithe of course, he keeps our land safe from any invaders and the Saradominists who want to kill us all. [Tithe? What do you mean?] Ah, well, in return for his protection, we have to give Lord Drakan a share of blood every week. If we don't have any to spare from our hunts, then we need to pick a member of the village to give their life in return for the blood so that the tithe is fulfilled.}} ==Locations== === Buildings === {| class="wikitable" !Building !Description |- |[[Barkers' Haberdashery]] [[File:Clothes shop icon.png]] |A clothes shop selling coloured clothing. All items cost 650 [[coins]] each except for capes. |- |[[Canifis bank]] [[File:Bank icon.png]] |One of the only banks in [[Morytania]] available at a low level. |- |[[General Store (Canifis)|Canifis general store]] [[File:General_store_icon.png]] |A [[general store]] which only buys at the lowest price, and where items cost twice the standard. |- |[[Hair of the Dog]] [[File:Pub icon.png]] |A large [[List of bars and pubs|inn]], in which there are several [[quests|quest]]-related [[Non-player character|NPCs]]. Behind the inn is a [[Trapdoor (Canifis)|trapdoor]] [[File:Agility shortcut icon.png]] to [[Mort'ton]]. |- |[[Mausoleum]] |A graveyard with the [[Grave (Creature of Fenkenstrain)|graves]] of the previous lords of [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]]. |- |Old crone's home |The home of the [[old crone]], who lives in solitude north of the town. |- |[[Rufus' Meat Emporium]] [[File:Food shop icon.png]] |A shop selling all kinds of [[raw meat]]. |- |Tannery [[File:Tannery icon.png]] |[[Sbott]] the [[tanner]] will tan [[cowhide]]s or [[dragonhide]]s for you here. |- |Taxidermy [[File:Taxidermist icon.png]] |The [[Taxidermist]] will stuff any [[Skill Hall#Head trophy|monster heads]] or [[Skill Hall#Fishing trophy|big fish]] you catch for a price |} ===Training areas=== Several intermediate training spots exist in Canifis: * A [[Mushroom|bittercap]] [[mushroom patch]], the only mushroom patch in the game, is located just west of town. * The [[Canifis Rooftop Course|Canifis Rooftop Agility Course]], the shortest [[Agility|Agility course]] in the game, is available to players at level 40 [[Agility]]. * The [[experiment cave]] contains great monsters for low-intensity melee training. * The northern [[ghoul]] grounds features 12 ghouls, great for [[Slayer tasks]]. The Salve graveyard is just north of the swamp, with another 10 ghouls walking it. * The [[Slayer Tower]], a multi-level castle with various [[Slayer]] monsters, is found north of the town. === Spawns === {| class="wikitable" !Item !Spawns !Location !Map |- |{{Plink|Pickled brain}} |1 |Hair of the Dog tavern |{{map|3492,3474|type=maplink|mtype=pin|group=Pickled brain}} |} ==Inhabitants== === Werewolf citizens === If you attack any of the human citizens of Canifis, they turn into level 88 [[Werewolf|werewolves]]. If you wield the [[Wolfbane]] dagger, you can fight the men and women without them turning into werewolves. The werewolf citizens are [[Alexis]], [[Boris]], [[Eduard]], [[Galina]], [[Georgy]], [[Imre]], [[Irina]], [[Joseph]], [[Ksenia]], [[Lev]], [[Liliya]], [[Milla]], [[Nikita]], [[Nikolai]], [[Sofiya]], [[Svetlana]], [[Vera]], [[Yadviga]], [[Yuri]], and [[Zoja]]. === Other personalities === * {{Chatl|Achtryn}}, a stand-in for Mazchna during [[While Guthix Sleeps]]. * {{Chatl|Agility Boss|txt=Agility boss}}, a yellow-suited werewolf who throws a stick for the player to fetch. * Five {{Chatl|Agility Trainer|txt=Agility trainers}}, who stand around the Agility course. * Two{{Chatl|Banker (Canifis)|txt=bankers}}, who help players access the [[Bank of Gielinor]]. * {{Chatl|Barker}}, a werewolf clothier who sells colourful robes. * {{Chatl|Fidelio}}, a general-store owner who sells items at much higher prices than most. * {{Chatl|Le-sabrè}}, the taskmaster for the [[Morytania diaries]]. * {{Chatl|Malak}}, an arrogant vampyre noble. * {{Chatl|Mazchna}}, the second lowest-level [[Slayer Master]]. * {{Chatl|Roavar}}, a bartender, werewolf, and town gossip. * {{Chatl|Rufus}}, a human-form werewolf who runs the raw meat shop. * {{Chatl|Sbott}}, a human-form werewolf who runs the tannery. * {{Chatl|Skullball Boss|txt=Skullball boss}}, a werewolf in charge of the [[skullball course]]. * Six {{Chatl|Skullball Trainer|txt=skullball trainers}}, who stand around the skullball course. * {{Chatl|Stranger (In Search of the Myreque)|txt=Stranger}}, a stranger who replaces [[Vanstrom Klause]] after his leave. * {{Chatl|Taxidermist}}, an unpleasant-smelling lady who stuffs animal trophies. * {{Chatl|Vanstrom Klause|pic=Vanstrom Klause (hooded) chathead}}, an evil vampyre who wants to destroy the local human resistance. * {{Chatl|Werewolf (Werewolf Agility
